faces.flavor: You were unable to locate Sabik's operatives in time. Explosives detonated in several locations of both cities, killing a handful of Soviet scientists but almost a hundred civilians as well. A forensic sweep revealed that the explosives matched those taken by Sabik from the Langley armory earlier this month.
